title: Teaching Material Question Bank
description: Per EO-S1.1-001 v1.1, refined by EO-S1.1-002 v1.0, refined again by EO-S1.1-002A v1.0 (Question Source Rule). At minimum single_choice/true_false/fill_blank; calculation/essay added only when the source material genuinely supports them. Every question must carry a source trace — never a bare, untraceable question. EO-S1.1-002A: questionSource (ORIGINAL | AI_GENERATED) and origin ('Uploaded Material' | 'AI') together are mandatory and must pair consistently — enforced by scripts/ValidateMaterial.js, not just this schema (plain JSON Schema draft-07 can't express the pairing rule without an if/then this hand-rolled Repository intentionally keeps simple). 'id' is renamed 'questionId' to match EO-S1.1-002A's exact field name.

materialId.description: Mirrors the parent record's materialId — EO-S1.1-002A lists it as its own per-question Metadata field

questionSource.description: ORIGINAL: 段考/模擬考/歷屆試題/教師試卷/作業/課本習題 — copied verbatim, never rewritten/simplified/reorganized/polished/AI-corrected. AI_GENERATED: Claude-derived from the material's real content.

origin.description: Must pair with questionSource: ORIGINAL -> 'Uploaded Material', AI_GENERATED -> 'AI'. (Note: a differently-valued 'origin' field existed under EO-S1.1-002 ('AI'/'Original') — EO-S1.1-002A's own Metadata list redefines it with these exact two values, which this schema follows as the more recent LOCK.)

needsManualReview.description: ORIGINAL only. EO-S1.1-002A: '若 OCR 信心不足，不得猜測，必須標記需人工確認' — true when OCR/transcription confidence was insufficient to be certain the question text is verbatim; Claude must never guess in that case. Defaults to false; omitted entirely for AI_GENERATED questions (the concept doesn't apply).

version.description: Starts "1"; incremented if this specific question is later corrected/re-transcribed

source.description: Traceability to the real source material — never fabricated
